value.title: Exhaustive two-law deterministic-transplant certificate
value.summary:
Accepted statement:

Append-only correction of canonical transaction 1075dd02e8f83427a17b3f9f1391dfbb9e6d0a82, which is a corrective/provenance reference rather than a mathematical premise: for the two exact rational 2x4x4x9 auxiliary laws vendored from the pinned Huang--Liu--Liu certificate, an exhaustive standard-library scan evaluates all 2 * 4^9 = 524,288 deterministic maps of the nine source input labels to the four half-skew BSSC two-use super-inputs. Outward entropy intervals prove that the maximum half-weight Marton value over this finite family lies in [0.5451904011322205365, 0.5451904011322206215] bits and hence is strictly below 2 L_RTD. Source row 7 and base-four map ID 243761, namely (1,0,3,0,0,2,3,2,3), give the certified lower endpoint. No value within that enclosure is asserted to greater precision. This is a fixed-law deterministic-map family only: it excludes stochastic relabelings, changes to the auxiliary laws, mixtures or continuations, local-search campaigns, an unrestricted Marton-additivity theorem, and a capacity converse.

Scope qualifications (verbatim):
- The result applies only to the two pinned exact rational auxiliary laws and deterministic maps from nine labels to four two-use BSSC super-inputs.
- It excludes stochastic relabelings, altered auxiliary laws, mixtures or continuations, local-search campaigns, unrestricted Marton additivity, and any capacity converse.
- No value inside the certified enclosure is claimed to greater precision.
- The local source bytes are pinned, but their external repository history is not independently authenticated; this is provenance rather than a mathematical premise.

value.title: Exhaustive outward-entropy transplant computation
value.summary: Computation used to establish the linked accepted claim. A standard-library verifier checks the two pinned exact rational auxiliary laws, constructs outward entropy intervals for their induced half-skew BSSC product-channel distributions, and exhaustively evaluates all 524,288 deterministic law-map pairs. It certifies the stated global enclosure, the row-7 map-ID-243761 lower endpoint, and the strict comparison with the required directed value of 2 L_RTD. The computation covers only the fixed deterministic-map family in the accepted statement and does not cover stochastic relabelings, altered laws, mixtures, continuations, unrestricted Marton optimization, or capacity converses.

placementAudits.rationale: The accepted result is a rigorously certified no-gain computation for a precisely bounded family of two-letter Marton laws, so its narrowest coherent local objective is the existing multiletter Marton achievability program and its fixed-law transplant-certificate verification thread.
